verdict.rationale: The hosted r.jina.ai service has no documented region or residency selection. Users can still control where their data lives by self-hosting the open-source branch from the prebuilt container image and pointing the page cache at an S3-compatible bucket they choose, which is a workaround rather than a residency feature. missing for 10: region/residency selection on the hosted SaaS API, documented data-location or retention policy for hosted requests, independent corroboration of self-hosted residency control.
